amphipolis.controller

Class Controller

  • java.lang.Object
    • amphipolis.controller.Controller

  • public class Controller
extends java.lang.Object
    The Controller class acts as the central coordinator of the MVC architecture. It manages the game loop, enforces rules and synchronizes the Model state with the View. Invariant: There is always exactly one active player during a turn. Invariant: The game state is explicitly tracked. Invariant: The Controller maintains a valid reference to the Board and the Players throughout the game lifecycle.

    • Method Detail

      • startGame

        public void startGame()
        Starts the game setup process. Pre-condition: The game must not already be running. Post-condition: Initializes Players, Board, Bag, and starts the first turn.

      • startTurn

        public void startTurn()
        Begins a new turn for the current player. Pre-condition: A turn is not currently in progress (the previous player must have finished). Post-condition: The current player draws 4 tiles. If a Landslide occurs, handleLandslide is called.

      • endTurn

        public void endTurn()
        Ends the current player's turn manually. Pre-condition: The player must be in the Action Phase of their turn. Post-condition: Control passes to the next player index. startTurn() is called for them.

      • handleLandslide

        private void handleLandslide(LandslideTile t)
        Handles the special logic when a Landslide Tile is drawn.
        Parameters:
        t - The landslide tile that was drawn.

      • stealAllTiles

        private void stealAllTiles(Zone zone)
        Moves all tiles from a specific zone to the Thief's collection. This is used in Single Player mode when a Landslide occurs. Post-condition: The specified zone becomes empty.
        Parameters:
        zone - The zone from which to steal tiles.

      • checkGameOver

        private void checkGameOver(EntranceZone zone)
        Checks if the game should end based on the Entrance Zone status.
        Parameters:
        zone - The entrance zone to check. Post-condition: If zone.isFull() is true, gameFinished becomes true and winners are calculated.

      • calculateStatuePoints

        private java.util.Map<Player,java.lang.Integer> calculateStatuePoints()
        Calculates the points awarded for Statue tiles Points are awarded based on who has the majority of each statue type. Pre-condition: The game must be in the scoring phase. Post-condition: Returns a map associating each player with their statue bonus points.
        Returns:
        A Map where Key = Player and Value = Points from statues.

      • assignMajorityPoints

        private java.util.Map<Player,java.lang.Integer> assignMajorityPoints(java.util.Map<Player,java.lang.Integer> currentPoints,
                                                                     boolean isSphinx)
        Helper method to determine the majority owner for a specific type of statue. Rules: 6 points for most, 3 for others, 0 for least.
        Parameters:
        currentPoints - The map of points accumulated so far.
        isSphinx - True to calculate for Sphinxes, False for Caryatids.
        Returns:
        The updated map of points.

      • useCharacter

        public void useCharacter()
        Handles the logic for using a Character card's special ability. Validates the player's selection and delegates the action to the specific Character subclass. Checks if the character has already been used and updates the view upon success.

      • selectZone

        public Zone selectZone(Zone forbiddenZone,
                       boolean ignoreForbidden)
        Prompts the user to select a zone via the View.
        Parameters:
        forbiddenZone - The zone the player visited previously (can be null).
        ignoreForbidden - If true, the forbiddenZone restriction is ignored (e.g. Assistant).
        Returns:
        The selected Zone object.

      • howmany

        public int howmany()
        Prompts the user to select how many tiles they want to draw. typically used for the Digger character.
        Returns:
        The number of tiles selected by the user (1 or 2).

      • startTimer

        private void startTimer()
        Initializes and starts the turn timer. If the timer reaches 0, it automatically ends the turn.

      • playMusicForPlayer

        private void playMusicForPlayer(int playerIndex)
        Plays the background music associated with the current player. Now updated to play .wav files natively.
        Parameters:
        playerIndex - The index of the player (0-3).

      • toggleMute

        public void toggleMute()
        Toggles the game's audio mute state. Stops the music if muted, or resumes the current player's track if unmuted. Updates the view's mute button text.

      • playLandslideSound

        private void playLandslideSound()
        Plays a specific sound effect indicating a landslide occurred. This uses a standard WAV file for compatibility.
